in_marathi.name: Ramya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ramya is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, and it is a feminine form of the name Rama, which is the name of a famous Hindu goddess and the consort of Lord Vishnu. The name Rama is believed to mean 'pleasing to look at' or 'delighting', and the name Ramya symbolizes beauty, grace, and divine femininity. In Hindu mythology, Goddess Rama is known for her virtues of purity, compassion, and strength.
